products.name: Godrej Eon Rhine 10 kg top-load washer with in-built heater
products.summary: Lift the soft-shut glass lid to see the Quadra steel pulsator and the lint filters, read the rear control panel, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: 102 cm tall to the top of the rear control panel; with the lid open it is about 140 cm
specs: In-built, washes with water up to 60°C
Auto / Mix Fabric, Tub Clean, Hot Wash, Saree, Cotton, Woollens, Bulky / Denim, Anti Wrinkle, Quick Wash, Delicate / Baby Care
Zero Pressure Technology, washes at 0.02 MPa at the inlet
Touch keys and digital display on the rear panel
Delay Start, Child Lock, Auto Resume, Extra Rinse, Cycle End Buzzer, Unbalanced Load Detection
5 years comprehensive*, 10 years on the wash motor

hotspots.title: Water-protected rear control panel
hotspots.text: Controls at the back enable easy removal of wet clothes without the panel getting wet.

hotspots.title: Soft-shut glass lid
hotspots.text: The durable tinted toughened-glass lid closes gently for safer, quieter everyday use.

hotspots.title: Quadra Steel Pulsator
hotspots.text: The strong stainless-steel pulsator creates powerful water movement for effective cleaning while helping maintain wash hygiene.

hotspots.title: Dual Magic Lint Filter
hotspots.text: Dual lint filters trap lint, fluff and debris during the wash to help keep clothes cleaner.
